summary: Iteration 74 - Enhanced Recurring Billing Module + Invoice Email Feature Testing Complete. Backend: 16/16 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All features verified working correctly including KPI stats, 12-month forecast chart, enhanced template cards with expand/collapse, and invoice email dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: Enhanced recurring billing module correctly implements all requested features
KPI stats row displays MRR, ARR, Active Templates, Due for Generation, Total Templates
12-Month Revenue Forecast bar chart renders correctly with projected values
Template cards show all enhanced fields: status badge, AUTO-SEND badge, escalation % badge, amount/frequency, next generation date, generation count
Expand/collapse on template cards reveals: Contract Period, Payment Terms, Total Billed, Collection Rate, Notes, Line Items with subtotal/tax/total, Generated Invoice History
Invoice Email dialog shows invoice preview (client, amount, due date, status), recipient email field, subject field, message field, send button
Email sending is MOCKED (logged to MongoDB, not actually sent via Resend)
seed_data_creation: Recurring templates auto-seeded on first access with 8 templates including various frequencies (weekly, monthly, quarterly, yearly)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Enhanced recurring billing and invoice email features fully tested.
